railClipping.method: Routes are simplified, then clipped to the dissolved projected union of Tokyo’s 23 special wards.

hotelDecisionBaseline.method: Bounds include all five hotels, all stay-decision stations, linked orientation stations, and the four hotel wards, then add controlled padding and fit the map aspect ratio.

publicDefault100View.method: The approved public 100% view uses the complete generated viewport; closer inspection scales this same view without changing geography.
